meta.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

events.label: Hermione uses Time-Turner to stack classes
events.description: Hermione has quietly been carrying a magic pendant that lets her step back a few hours at a time, so she can attend two lessons running at the same moment - and no one has noticed.

events.label: Shrieking Shack: Pettigrew exposed; Sirius innocent
events.description: In the old, boarded-up Shrieking Shack the truth comes out at last: the man everyone blamed for betraying Harry's parents was innocent, and the real traitor was hiding all along as Ron's pet rat.

events.label: Pettigrew flees as Lupin transforms
events.description: Just as the traitor is about to be handed over, the full moon rises and turns their werewolf ally into a monster - and in the confusion the guilty man changes into a rat and scurries away.

events.label: Dementors overwhelm Harry and Sirius by the lake
events.description: Down by the lake, the hooded soul-drinking guards swarm around Harry and the wrongly accused man, draining every happy thought from them until Harry can barely stand.

events.label: Mysterious stag Patronus drives Dementors off; Harry thinks it is his father
events.description: At the last second a brilliant silver stag charges out of the darkness and scatters the guards - and Harry, half-conscious, is sure the creature looks exactly like his long-dead father.

events.label: Hospital wing; Dumbledore prompts the one thing
events.description: Back in the hospital wing, the headmaster, guessing what must be done, tells Harry and Hermione that they have one chance to change things - and warns them not to be seen.

events.label: Three Time-Turner turns; rewind three hours
events.description: Hermione spins her pendant three times, and the whole evening begins again as the pair are thrown three hours into their own past.

events.label: Harry and Hermione arrive three hours earlier
events.description: Harry and Hermione find themselves standing in the entrance hall three hours before everything went wrong, watching events they remember unfold from the outside.

events.label: Free Buckbeak before execution (axe hits pumpkin)
events.description: They slip out to the grounds and rescue the doomed creature Hagrid loves - luring it away just before the executioner's axe falls, so the only sound it makes is chopping a pumpkin.

events.label: Hermione signals to avoid past-Harry noticing too soon
events.description: Hermione keeps their earlier selves from spotting them too soon, careful that the two versions of each of them never come face to face.

events.label: Harry casts the stag Patronus that saved them
events.description: Waiting by the lake, Harry suddenly understands: the magnificent stag he saw was no ghost of his father - it was himself, and now he must conjure it to save his past self.

events.label: Free Sirius via Buckbeak flight from tower
events.description: With the guards closing in on the innocent man locked in the tower, Hermione whisks him out of a high window on the back of the rescued creature, and he flies off to freedom.

events.label: Return to hospital wing moments after leaving
events.description: Having done everything in those borrowed hours, they hurry back to the hospital wing and slip in just seconds after their earlier selves left it.

events.label: Hermione surrenders Time-Turner; loop closed
events.description: The evening closes neatly on itself: Hermione gives the pendant back, everything that happened that night had happened all along, and no timeline ever changed.

events.label: Dementor attacks
events.description: The prison guards' soul-draining attack by the lake leaves Harry and his godfather helpless and nearly lost for good.

events.label: Buckbeak execution threat
events.description: A gentle hippogriff - a horse-eagle hybrid - is sentenced to death for wounding a spoiled student, and Hagrid can do nothing to save his beloved pet.

events.label: Sirius revealed innocent
events.description: Harry learns that the man who betrayed his parents was not his godfather Sirius, but their old friend Peter Pettigrew, who has been hiding in plain sight for years.

events.label: Time-Turner hours with Hermione
events.description: Hermione reveals her secret device for borrowing hours, and lets Harry in on how she has been attending overlapping lessons all year.

events.label: Save Buckbeak
events.description: The rescue of the condemned creature is the first thing the pair do with their rewound hours, saving it from the executioner's blade.

events.label: Harry's Patronus saves self
events.description: Standing alone by the dark lake, Harry casts a Patronus of breathtaking power - the silver stag - and realises with awe that the saviour he admired was himself all along.

events.label: Sirius escapes
events.description: Sirius Black, innocent of the crime he was imprisoned for, escapes the tower on the back of a flying creature and goes into hiding.

events.label: Must not be seen; closed evening loop
events.description: The pendant's magic has iron rules: no one must ever see their own other self, and what happened that night must unfold exactly as it did - it already has.

edges.label: future self was always the savior

ruleEffects.effect: Second pass fulfills events already observed; no rewrite
Patronus has no external caster other than future Harry
You already changed the past — by becoming it

outcome.summary: Buckbeak and Sirius saved by actions that were always part of the evening; Time-Turner later removed from circulation.
